Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. The 2023 Honda Civic Sport Touring is a standout vehicle that combines style, technology, and safety, making it an excellent choice for anyone in the market for a new car. With its powerful 1.5L I-4 gasoline direct injection engine, delivering 180HP through a seamless CVT, the Civic Sport Touring offers an exhilarating driving experience while maintaining impressive fuel efficiency.

One of the most notable features of the Civic Sport Touring is its advanced safety technology. The **Hands-on steering assist/lane centering** system enhances your driving experience by allowing you to set your speed and letting the vehicle maintain a safe distance from others, effectively reducing road trip stress. This is complemented by the **Forward collision mitigation** system, which proactively helps prevent accidents by sensing potential impacts and preparing the vehicle accordingly.

Additionally, the **Front pedestrian impact prevention** feature is a game-changer, constantly monitoring the road ahead for pedestrians and taking necessary actions to avoid collisions. The **Rear camera** provides an extra layer of safety, displaying enhanced images of what’s behind you, ensuring you can navigate tight spaces effortlessly.

The **Lane departure prevention** system is another excellent feature, alerting you if you unintentionally drift out of your lane and taking corrective measures to keep you safely positioned. This is especially beneficial in busy urban environments or during long drives where fatigue can set in.

For those who enjoy long road trips, the **Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go** feature is invaluable. This system allows you to maintain a safe distance from the vehicle ahead, automatically adjusting speed and even bringing your car to a stop if necessary. This feature, along with the **Brake assist**, ensures that you can react quickly in emergency situations, enhancing your overall safety.

The Civic Sport Touring also comes equipped with **Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls** for added convenience and a **Voice activated integrated navigation system**, making it easy to navigate without distractions.

In summary, the 2023 Honda Civic Sport Touring is a well-rounded vehicle that prioritizes safety and driver convenience while offering a powerful performance. With its impressive array of features and advanced technology, it’s no wonder that this model stands out in the competitive compact car market. Whether you’re commuting or on a road trip, the Civic Sport Touring is designed to keep you safe and comfortable every mile of the way.

The 2017 Honda Fit EX-L is a compact vehicle that excels in practicality and comfort. This model is designed with a 1.5L I-4 gasoline direct injection engine that delivers an impressive 130HP, paired with a Continuously Variable Transmission CVT. This feature serves as an added set of eyes, helping drivers navigate tight spaces with confidence. Additionally, the brake assist technology is a game-changer. Just speak your destination, and the system guides you effortlessly. Complementing these tech features are heated front seats, providing warmth and comfort during chilly drives, enhancing the overall driving experience.

The luxurious leather seat upholstery adds a touch of elegance to the cabin, while the touchscreen interface makes it easy to control various vehicle functions at your fingertips. For those who enjoy fresh air and natural light, the first-row power express open/close moonroof allows for a more open and airy cabin atmosphere.

With variable valve timing and gasoline direct injection, the Honda Fit EX-L optimizes performance and fuel efficiency, ensuring a smooth and economical drive. This compact car is not just about functionality, its also about delivering a pleasant driving experience.

In conclusion, the 2017 Honda Fit EX-L is a well-rounded vehicle that combines safety, technology, and comfort, making it a top contender in the compact car market. If youre looking for a reliable and efficient vehicle, the Fit EX-L is certainly worth considering.

description: If you love fun, performance, and everyday practicality wrapped into one compact package, the 2017 Volkswagen Golf R continues to be one of the most compelling sport hatchbacks on the road even with over 114,000 miles. This Golf R has earned a passionate following for good reason: it blends sharp handling,lively performance, all-weather confidence, and surprising versatility in a way that few cars can match.At its core, the Golf R is a true driver s car. With all-wheel drive and a performance-tuned chassis, the Golf R feels planted and eager, yet remains a truly usable hatch for groceries, errands, or road trips.Consumer reviews for the 2017 Golf R are overwhelmingly positive, giving high marks for performance, comfort, interior quality, and fun factor with many recommending it as one of the best small cars they ve owned.For a 2017 Volkswagen Golf R with ~114,000 miles, you re looking at a confidence-inspiring hot hatch that still feels lively, capable, and truly fun to drive:Sporty turbocharged performance with punchy acceleration and AWD grip.Engaging handling and road manners that make driving satisfying.Comfortable, practical interior that still feels upscale among hatchbacks.Versatility and daily usability that pairs well with its performance DNA.If well-maintained, this Golf R can feel agile, fun, and surprisingly capable even at higher mileage making it a standout choice for enthusiasts and practical drivers alike who want a hatchback that truly delivers excitement every time you get behind the wheel.

But the hatchback was the insider s pick. More aggressive styling, more utility, more personality, and a distinctly European-inspired feel made it the Civic many buyers wished they had chosen the first time.Then there is the Sport trim. Center-exit exhaust, sharper body styling, firmer attitude, and a more athletic presence gave it genuine character. Add the upgraded bronze wheels and performance-minded stance on this example, and it looks like something far more expensive than its badge suggests. It has presence. It has intent. It has zero interest in blending in with traffic.The 6-speed manual transmission is the headline act. In a world flooded with numb CVTs and forgettable automatics, this Civic offers crisp shifts, direct feedback, and the kind of engagement that turns routine errands into reasons to take the long way home. Paired with Honda engineering, it delivers fun without punishing ownership costs.Inside, you still get the practicality that made the Civic famous. Reverse camera, modern controls, supportive seating, smart storage, and hatchback cargo flexibility mean this car works Monday through Friday just as well as it does on a canyon road Saturday morning. Few cars can claim that honestly.Compare it with a Volkswagen GTI, Mazda3 Hatchback, Toyota Corolla Hatchback, Ford Focus, or Subaru Impreza and the Civic continues to win buyers with its balance of style, efficiency, resale value, and everyday livability.It is the intelligent enthusiast choice quick enough to enjoy, practical enough to justify, and proven enough to trust.If you ve been searching for a used Honda Civic Hatchback manual in Sacramento, this one separates itself immediately. Black on black attitude, Enkei Tuning wheels, Acuity short shift on a rare 6-speed manual transmission, and one of the best hatchback platforms Honda ever built.Sharp looks, upgraded stance, and everyday Honda excellence this is the kind of car people regret waiting on.
